findings.body:
**Block worker `git push` so every publication passes the pre-push scan.**

The conflict worker can push directly. `resolveConflict.ts:618` allows `bash`, and `resolveConflict.ts:619` sets sandbox level `none`. No inspected code blocks `git push` through that tool. The driver keeps the CLI's own permission model for `run` commands (`src/driver/claude-code/cli.ts:108-113`). The only restraint is prompt text at `src/ops/merge/prompts/conflict.default.md:13`, which says "do not run `git push` (any form)."

The repository contract requires publication through the scan gate. `mergeEffects.ts:543-544` says the publication push "runs through this seam behind the scan gate, never from the worker." The denylist scan checks the added lines a push publishes (`src/ops/dev/denylist.ts:337-340`). A direct worker push can publish a credential-bearing commit that this scan never sees.

The module header also tells the worker it "MUST push the resolved branch" (`resolveConflict.ts:17`). That contradicts the prompt and the seam contract. Correct that comment with the enforcement change.

A safe fix needs a tool-level block on `git push` that keeps the commit and fetch steps working. The inspected code does not establish that mechanism, so no code change is proposed here.
findings.title: Block worker `git push` so every publication passes the pre-push scan.
Return protected-branch mismatch as a `failed` result instead of throwing.
